ignoreCommand: case "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" in main) exit 1;; production) printf '%s\n' "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_MESSAGE" | head -n 1 | grep -q '^chore(main): release ' && exit 1;; esac; exit 0
buildCommand: case "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" in main|production) DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED:-$DATABASE_URL}" pnpm db:migrate || exit 1;; esac; pnpm build
